title: Being a local complete intersection over a field is invariant under extension of the field
statement: Let $k$ and $K$ be fields, $\iota:k\to K$ a ring homomorphism (making $K$ a $k$-algebra), and $S$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Then $S\otimes_kK$, a $K$-algebra through $\lambda\mapsto1\otimes\lambda$, is a finite type $K$-algebra, and $S$ is a local complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field] if and only if $S\otimes_kK$ is a local complete intersection over $K$.
